summary: VERDICT: PASS. Independent read-only trace of request->validation->authn/authz-boundary->service->repository->persistence->event->queue->response across 19 modules (artist-goals, briefings, campaigns, clients, content-detections, contract-service-types, contract-templates, conversations, ecad-reports, events, hr, invoices, phonograms, projects, releases, shares, support-tickets, transactions, users, works), scoped to internal API/domain/event/job wiring only (auth/tenancy/billing/migrations/external-integrations explicitly excluded, owned by other reviewers). Found 5 real findings: 1 event-naming/wiring drift (conversations.service.ts misusing DOMAIN_EVENTS.LEAD_UPDATED for conversation-creation, no real consumer) and 4 instances of a systemic query-filter DTO/service drift pattern (contract-templates, briefings, artist-goals, content-detections, ecad-reports) where declared query DTO fields and the fields the service actually reads have silently diverged post-rename -- confirmed as a known, previously-fixed anti-pattern by cross-referencing events.dto.ts's own comment documenting the identical bug class being fixed there. No P0/P1 findings: shares (split-invariant + advisory-lock concurrency control), hr (payroll idempotency key, atomic leave-approval transition), invoices (dedup'd overdue scheduler + idempotent follow-up task creation), transactions (idempotency interceptor + Zod validation), works/events (already-hardened DTO field-contract with explicit dtoToEntity mapping) all traced clean with no double-apply, no dead APIs, no swallowed-error-hides-real-bug patterns beyond documented 'auxiliary, non-blocking' try/catch (activity-log/timeline writes) which is an intentional, commented design choice, not a defect.
